test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a row of 28 students, Jamuna was 12th from the extreme left end and Ganga was 19th from the extreme right end. If Sarasvati was seated exactly between them, then what was Sarasvati's position from the right end? Assume that the students were seated facing north.
solution:
1. In a row of 28 students, Jamuna was 12th from the extreme left end.

 
• This implies that Jamuna was 17th from the extreme right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ceea9c5bacb233b16718e18f5721f523146b9f8f7627a42c2dc7f8932ba438e.png] 

2. Ganga was 19th from the extreme right end. 

3. If Sarasvati was seated exactly between them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/483eeef5e26355731d41765e479da94ccd32a207f00f67d8b4cf3ae934abf60b.png] 

Clearly, Sarasvati is 18th from the right end.

Hence, ‘**18th**’ is the correct answer.
